The claims are unverified, as the gang had not yet published proof. loanDepot disclosed a cyber incident on January 6 and confirmed a ransomware attack on January 8, affecting at least 16.6 million people. Prudential said a suspected cybercrime group breached its network on February 4 and stole employee and contractor data, with no evidence yet of customer data theft. 415047041e97e6592db5c6e845f500aa29c01092.summary: SEAL Intel analyses a malicious repository tied to the DPRK 'Contagious Interview' campaign, which targets developers with take-home technical assessments sent via LinkedIn. Infection can follow cloning the repository and enabling VS Code trusted workspace, or running the application. A Node.js layer steals credentials, keys and wallet data, and a Python layer adds remote access and cryptocurrency mining. The malware is linked to InvisibleFerret and BeaverTail. Persistence works only on Windows, and the report recommends a full OS reset after infection.
